title: Pakson’s Colourful Parade

timeline.speaker: narrator
timeline.text: It was parade morning at Clover's little sewing studio. Bright ribbons fluttered in the sunshine, and four special outfits were waiting to be chosen.

timeline.speaker: clover
timeline.text: Morning, Pakson! Ready to pick four colourful things for today's parade?

timeline.speaker: pakson
timeline.text: Yes! Let's look around, Clover!
